description: Three prompt classes x three runs, 512 max output tokens, temperature 0.7, concurrency 1, at 131072-token context. Decode tokens per second per run, plus a long-prompt prefill probe.

hardware.profile: Apple silicon laptop, 48 GB unified memory
notes: Model fully resident in unified memory

prefillProbe.note: Prefill dominates wall time; the rate is an end-to-end estimate including decode, not an isolated prefill measurement.

notes: Decode speed is essentially flat versus the 32K-context run; context length itself costs little at these prompt sizes.
Long-context use is prefill-bound, not decode-bound.
caveats: Throughput probe only; no quality grading in this run.
